article.title: Minor’s acquisition of new domicile.
article.content:
17Minor’s acquisition of new domicile.

Section 17  ·  Part II  ·  page 20 of the Act
Save as hereinbefore otherwise provided in this Part, a person cannot, during minority, acquire a new domicile.
